name: PhoneBridger
offer: Windows and Android connected workspace; private beta website and local interactive demo.
audience: People who use a Windows PC with one or more Android phones at their desk.
facts: Owner-approved contact: hello@phonebridger.com. Website language: English. Native mouse implementation is frozen. Website sample messages, files, news, creator sales, earnings and payouts are fictional and remain outside public editorial packages. File transfer in the browser is a simulation; native file dragging is planned. Public domain ownership, release distribution, product policies, production sales/fulfilment and creator terms require separate verification. Proposed owner-delegated launch USD prices: App29, +1 holder49, +2 holders65, +3 holders79; no open checkout. Eleven inner pages and local-only email/password accounts are private previews, not production licences. Creator extension is deferred by the latest owner instruction.
